newsitem.title: GERMANY: Deutsche - no plans for sales of industrial stakes.
newsitem.headline: Deutsche - no plans for sales of industrial stakes.

text.p: Deutsche Bank AG said on Wednesday it did not intend at present to sell its industrial shareholdings as long as taxes remained as high as they are.
"As long as the tax situation remains unchanged, we won't sell. If the situation changes, we will have to rethink," chief executive Hilmar Kopper told a news conference.
He added that he was happy with the recent stock market performance of Deutsche's industrial holdings, which range from stakes in Daimler-Benz AG to builder Philipp Holzmann AG.
Kopper also said that the purchase of a 5.21 percent stake in Bayerische Vereinsbank AG last year was "one of the better investments" of 1996 in terms of its share performance.
The purchase fuelled takeover speculation in the German banking sector.
Referring to the purchase, Kopper said: "We wanted to throw our hat into the ring and said 'We will look at Vereinsbank'".
